description: Feature 1 — Weight tracker + trend chart. Pure weight-trend math in framework-free src/lib/weight.ts (unit-tested), then UI under a nested Stats route (/stats/berat): numeric kg logging with validation + Gojek voice, entry list with delete, an attractive div/SVG + motion trend chart (NO charting lib), latest/change readouts, and a BMI-over-time readout tied to profiling.heightCm that gracefully hides when height is missing while still allowing logging. A compact weight summary Card links from Stats. Depends on FEAT-001 (WeightRecord type, weights table + src/db/weights.ts).
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file. Depends on FEAT-001 (weights table, src/db/weights.ts, WeightRecord). Do not re-create those.

Create framework-free src/lib/weight.ts (NO React, NO @/db import; takes WeightRecord[] + optional heightCm; import computeBmi/isValidHeight from @/lib/bmi, WeightRecord from @/types): `sortByTime(list): WeightRecord[]` (ascending by recordedAt), `latest(list): WeightRecord | null`, `deltas(list): { fromPrevious: number | null; fromFirst: number | null }` (null when fewer than 2 entries / single entry), `extremes(list): { min: number; max: number } | null` (null on empty), `changeOverPeriod(list, now: number, days: number): number | null` (weight change within the trailing window, null if insufficient data), `bmiSeries(list, heightCm?: number): { recordedAt: number; bmi: number }[]` (uses computeBmi; returns [] when heightCm is missing or !isValidHeight), `trendPoints(list): { recordedAt: number; weightKg: number }[]` for the chart. All pure + deterministic (inject now; no Date.now()).

Create src/lib/__tests__/weight.test.ts (vitest describe/it/expect, @/ alias) covering: empty list (latest null, deltas null, extremes null, bmiSeries []), single entry (deltas null, extremes min===max), multi-entry deltas (fromPrevious/fromFirst) + latest + extremes, changeOverPeriod across the window boundary (entries inside vs outside the trailing days), bmiSeries with a valid heightCm (recompute against a known case e.g. 170cm) and with missing/invalid heightCm (returns []).

src/lib/copy.ts: add a `weight` namespace to the `copy` object (Gojek voice, no emoji): screen title, 'Catat berat' button, kg input label + placeholder, invalid-range message (reuse the 30..300 kg bounds wording from bmi), empty state, delete-confirm title/body/yes/no, labels for latest weight / change-over-period / BMI-change readout, and a 'tinggi belum diisi' note shown when heightCm is missing so BMI-over-time is hidden but logging still works.

src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add IconKeys `weight`, `trend_up`, `trend_down`, `plus` mapped to verified io5 `IoScaleOutline`, `IoTrendingUp`, `IoTrendingDown`, `IoAddOutline`. Keep the map `satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`.

Create src/app/stats/berat/page.tsx — a thin 'use client' host (safe-top px-4 pt-8, h1 title from copy.weight) rendering <WeightTracker/>. Nested under /stats so Chrome.isTabRoute(startsWith '/stats') keeps the tab bar — do NOT touch layout files.

Create src/features/weight/WeightTracker.tsx ('use client'): useLiveQuery(() => db.weights.orderBy('recordedAt').toArray()); a numeric kg input validated with isValidWeight (from @/lib/bmi) + inline invalid message; 'Catat berat' writes via weights.add({ weightKg, recordedAt: Date.now() }) then clears the input and shows a toast (useToast); an entry list where each row shows weight + date (date-fns via @/lib/time) and a delete button opening a ConfirmDialog that calls weights.remove(id) (follow SessionRow.tsx). Read profiling.heightCm from useAppStore; compute latest/change via @/lib/weight; render the BMI-change readout only when heightCm is valid, otherwise show the copy.weight height note.

Create src/features/weight/WeightTrendChart.tsx ('use client') — a div/SVG + motion chart following WeeklyBarChart.tsx (scale against max/min of trendPoints, NO charting library); render a simple line or bar trend of weight over time with motion entrance. Accept the computed points as props so the chart stays presentational.

src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx: add a compact 'Berat badan' summary Card (latest weight + delta from @/lib/weight over a live query, or a friendly empty state when no entries) that links to /stats/berat (next/link or router.push). Keep all existing cards and the BMI card unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/weight.ts is React-free and exports sortByTime, latest, deltas, extremes, changeOverPeriod, bmiSeries, trendPoints with the described null/empty guards.
`npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/weight.test.ts` passes including empty/single/multi/window-boundary/bmi-missing-height cases.

/stats/berat renders: validated kg logging, an entry list with delete, a no-charting-lib trend chart, latest + change readouts, and a BMI-over-time readout that is hidden (with a friendly note) when profiling.heightCm is missing while logging still works.
A weight summary Card on Stats links to /stats/berat; the four layout files are unchanged vs HEAD.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run build` succeeds, and the no-emoji scan stays green.
findings:
DONE. Verified: weight.test.ts 14 passed, tsc clean, full vitest 205 passed (baseline 186 + 14 weight tests + 5 new no-emoji scan entries for the 5 new src files), lint 0 errors (only the 2 PRE-EXISTING warnings in src/lib/notifications.ts:162 and src/lib/recommendation.ts:256, both untouched), next build OK with a new static route /stats/berat (7.3 kB). Four layout files byte-identical to HEAD (empty git diff). Committed on main staging only the files touched by name.

EXPORTED SIGNATURES / things later FEATs can reuse:

src/lib/weight.ts (NEW, framework-free, no React, no @/db; imports computeBmi/isValidHeight from @/lib/bmi, WeightRecord from @/types):
- sortByTime(list: WeightRecord[]): WeightRecord[]  (ascending by recordedAt; returns a new array, input not mutated)
- latest(list: WeightRecord[]): WeightRecord | null  (null on empty; newest by recordedAt)
- deltas(list): { fromPrevious: number | null; fromFirst: number | null }  (both null when < 2 entries; latest-minus-previous and latest-minus-oldest)
- extremes(list): { min: number; max: number } | null  (null on empty)
- changeOverPeriod(list, now: number, days: number): number | null  (latest-in-window minus oldest-in-window using recordedAt >= now - days*86_400_000; null when < 2 entries fall inside the trailing window; now is injected, no Date.now())
- bmiSeries(list, heightCm?: number): { recordedAt: number; bmi: number }[]  (uses computeBmi; returns [] when heightCm is undefined or !isValidHeight)
- trendPoints(list): { recordedAt: number; weightKg: number }[]  (ascending, chart-ready)

src/types/index.ts: IconKey UNION extended with `weight`, `trend_up`, `trend_down`, `plus`.
src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: added mappings weight->IoScaleOutline, trend_up->IoTrendingUp, trend_down->IoTrendingDown, plus->IoAddOutline (map still `satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`). Later FEATs: keep adding keys the same way.

src/lib/copy.ts: added `copy.weight` namespace (screenTitle, summaryLabel, summaryEmpty, inputLabel/inputUnit('kg')/inputPlaceholder, logButton, invalidRange (30..300 kg wording), emptyTitle/emptyBody, saved, deleteConfirm{Title,Body,Yes,No}, deleteLabel, latestLabel, changeLabel('Perubahan 30 hari'), changeNone, bmiChangeLabel, trendTitle, heightMissingNote). All Gojek-voice, emoji-free.

UI (all 'use client'):
- src/app/stats/berat/page.tsx (NEW): thin host, h1 from copy.weight.screenTitle, renders <WeightTracker/>. Nested under /stats so Chrome.isTabRoute(startsWith '/stats') keeps the tab bar; NO layout file touched.
- src/features/weight/WeightTracker.tsx (NEW): useLiveQuery(db.weights.orderBy('recordedAt').toArray()); numeric kg input validated via isValidWeight (@/lib/bmi) with inline invalid message; 'Catat berat' writes weights.add({ weightKg, recordedAt: Date.now() }) then clears input + toast; entry list (newest-first) each row with delete opening a ConfirmDialog -> weights.remove(id); reads profiling.heightCm from useAppStore; renders latest + 30-day change readouts; BMI-change readout only when heightCm valid (bmiSeries non-empty), else shows copy.weight.heightMissingNote while logging still works.
- src/features/weight/WeightTrendChart.tsx (NEW): presentational SVG polyline + motion dots trend chart, NO charting lib (mirrors WeeklyBarChart div-only approach); accepts points: { recordedAt; weightKg }[] as props; scales against min/max, flat series -> mid-line; stroke uses var(--color-brand).

src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx (MODIFIED): added a live query over db.weights and a compact WeightSummaryCard (latest weight + delta-from-previous via @/lib/weight, friendly empty hint when none) wrapped in a next/link to /stats/berat. All existing cards (goal, BMI, stat grid, weekly chart) unchanged.

NO deviations from the FEAT-002 brief. No charting library added. DB access stays in src/db; pure math stays React-free in src/lib/weight.ts.
